name: Thabo Dlamini
bio:
Thabo's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, fueled by watching Formula 1 races with his father. He pursued a technical education, earning a diploma in Mechanical Engineering, with a specialization in quality assurance. Recognizing his keen eye for detail and commitment to excellence, he aims to ensure the highest standards of performance. 

He is a firm believer in a proactive approach to quality control, emphasizing preventative measures and continuous improvement. Thabo is always eager to learn new techniques and methodologies, making him a valuable asset to any racing team, even at this early stage of his career. He hopes to climb the ranks quickly.

physical.description: Thabo is of average height, with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils before starting a new task, no matter how small.
Keeps a detailed logbook of every quality control check, even the seemingly insignificant ones.
Drinks Rooibos tea religiously throughout the day.
